note: Charged-current single- and multi-pion production by muon neutrinos on CH (NuMI low-energy νμ beam, ⟨Eν⟩≈4.0 GeV), MINERvA tracker. Two exclusive/summed samples: CC1π± (exactly one charged pion, W<1.4 GeV) and CCNπ± (≥1 charged pion, "N-pion" sample, W<1.8 GeV, sum over all pions in event). Flux-integrated differential cross sections vs pion kinetic energy Tπ and vs pion lab angle θπ, all per nucleon. Both "full muon acceptance" (primary, no muon-angle cut) result sets ingested; the paper's alternative θμ<20° restricted-acceptance duplicates of all four tables exist in the same appendix but were NOT ingested (see caveats). Target: per nucleon (CH scintillator target; unit explicitly "10^-41 cm^2 / [degree|MeV] / nucleon" in every appendix table).
